title: Complete Binary Tree Inserter
description: Insert a node into a complete binary tree and maintain the complete binary tree property.
pseudocode:
1. queue = [root]
2. while queue[0].left and queue[0].right: 
3.   node = queue.shift()
4.   queue.push(node.left, node.right)
5. parent = queue[0]
6. if not parent.left: parent.left = new Node(val)
7. else: parent.right = new Node(val)

steps.note: Initialize BFS queue with root node (1).
Queue is [1], so parent is 1. Inserting target 2.
Parent 1 has no left child, insert 2 as left.
Next insert 3. Queue updated to [1, 2]. Parent is 1.
